name: FR-NIA
price_note: advertised early-bird Kickstarter price; the website lists a $999 MSRP and the campaign was still pre-launch on 2026-10-19
summary: An 11-inch desktop companion robot that gives conversational AI a moving silicone face and neck. Figurobot advertises 10 degrees of freedom, three versions (Lite, Pro, Pro Max) and an app for recording and editing expressions. Voice interaction relies on third-party language models; memory features are described as planned.
notable: Silicone-skinned expressive face with 7 facial DoF and a 3-DoF neck
